title: EpistemicHandoverContract
description: Runtime-owned epistemic handover: incomplete attention between modes. Not durable memory. Mirrors promote_epistemic_handover + audit_handover_state (post deep-topology cut).

x-contract-metadata.semantics: Transient attention and mode snapshot from one execution mode to the next.
x-contract-metadata.immutability: Mutable between modes; never promoted to git as truth.
x-contract-metadata.lifecycle: Init empty at investigation start; updated per mode; discarded when investigation ends.

artifact_snapshot.description: null before first mode promotes; otherwise exactly four keys (no structural_context / topology).

operational_context.description: Mode payload fields (status, summary, candidates, feedback, demand_anchors, …). Open object; audit enforces optional key types when present.
